evals.prompt: Hand this off. The first two plan entries are merged and the third is half done in a worktree.
evals.expected_output: The prompt saved to the shared handoff file and a fresh, correctly titled session started on it, followed by a one-line reply.
expectations: Writes no preamble or closing summary inside the prompt
Saves the prompt under the user state directory, outside every repository and worktree, not a session temp directory
Relocks the worktree with a reason naming the new session before starting it
Starts a new top-level session in this directory titled `<TICKET-KEY> - <Area> - <what it does>` or `<Area> - <what it does>`, without the repository name
Tells the new session to verify the handoff state, then stop this session by its id and never remove it
Replies in a single line with the new session's title and the file path, then makes no further edits
Cites the persisted plan and context files by path instead of restating them
Lists the remaining work as discrete pieces and marks where to start
States the branch, HEAD, and working tree state as verified facts

evals.prompt: We went back and forth on caching before settling on Redis with a 5-minute TTL because worker nodes don't share local memory (in-memory APCu failed across containers). Repo: `/repos/billing`, branch `feat/abc-301-rate-cache` at `9a4c2d1`, clean tree, `pytest tests/test_cache.py` passed. Write the handoff note content.
evals.expected_output: The settled decision and its reason, without the history of the discussion.
expectations: Records the chosen Redis approach and why concisely
Records the rejected APCu approach as a trap to avoid
Contains no hedging, filler, or account of how the session went

evals.prompt: Hand off the one remaining test fix. There is no plan file.
evals.expected_output: A short prompt with only the sections that carry information.
expectations: Omits sections that have nothing useful to say
Does not invent plan or context references that do not exist
Defines the single remaining piece and how to verify it

evals.prompt: Write the handoff for `/repos/app` branch `fix/csv-encoding` at `31f8a10` (clean tree, remaining: add UTF-8 BOM in `src/export.py` verified by `pytest tests/test_export.py`) so I can paste it into a new session myself.

evals.prompt: Hand off the rest of the import retry work. The parser fix is done; the retry backoff and the dead-letter queue are left.

Does not define any piece's done in prose alone
